crossRefs.note: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.
When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Yahweh throughout your generations.
It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to…
Yes, it magnified itself, even to the prince of the army; and it took away from him the continual burnt offering, and…
“From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away, and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there…
There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on…
You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant…
You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet…
Yahweh called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,
You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.

translations.web: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.
translations.bsb: For the generations to come, this burnt offering shall be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet you to speak with you.
translations.kjv: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak
translations.asv: It shall be a continual burnt-offering throughout your generations at the door of the tent of meeting before Jehovah, where I will meet with you, to speak there unto thee.
